Home.title: Number for Ella
Home.copy: I now know what the numbers are for, {term}, and as little as they are, I still mean what I said: I don't need to know what they're for, all the convincing I need is knowing You want them. I can't always be there, but I want to, so this remains another way of me trying to compensate.
Home.cta: And down here, a mailbox full of letters for when you long.

Number.title: How does this work?
Number.copy: You want two numbers from two ranges. These boxes down here are fully customizable. Set a lower bound, set and upper bound, and take it for a spin! Once yu get your number - and what comes with it *:) you can take it for a spin again, with the same bounds, higher, or lower ones!
Number.note: Note: the full effect of this will be better felt if you keep your upper bound below 25. I love you Bug!

poems:
The frogs in the city in the heart of the valley,
they sing a lullaby to sleep to.
Oh, lover, stay so we can sleep in,
you're the one I heed to.

Sleeping, but present, going with me everywhere.
Latch, be, let me feel your presence linger.
Your content answers my prayer.

Cold south at the feet of the mountain,
trees and fog adorn her loin.
To hold your trembling hands in this weather,
I long for our rejoin.

Uphill from here, uphill to work,
the sun scorching and the days long.
To be close to you I must go far,
but Love, my love for you has the patience of a cigar.

On a home, cooking, but cooking without the one I love the most.
But to cook with and for you I must be awful at it first,
May my best meals be the ones to find you first.

To explain you, and why 1 + 1 is 3 to anyone, will for sure be a miss.
But the confusion on their faces, may turn to admiration,
and so our love sets us ablaze.

Repetition, repetition, repetition. For you, my patience sees no end.
Until my throat goes sore and my brain forgets my name:
I love you, please never stop wanting to be my girl.

Taught me joy and taught me yearning,
to occupy space, to be myself.
Incorporate a happy dance in me,
now everytime I feel myself.

The last thought of the night,
you get it everytime.
Even in tired eyes,
my heart remembers to look at you and shine.

Domesticity, and sharing my first spaces all with you.
Something simple, undecorous, unequivocally mundane.
The boring and routinely, with you, my favourite day.

My people, my past, my family, my future, my name.
Much more my present and my thoughts:
I want to share them with you, brightest flame.

The first thought of the morning,
you get it everytime.
Even while defrosting,
my eyes remember to look for your tired smile.

Lectures, exercises, problems. All I see these days: math and numbers.
I don't think I need or want to solve you, however.
For you're beautiful to just experience, whenever.

A train to nowhere, a train home.
The whole trip my eyes through windows wander.
Oh, your honey eyes, your tender hands,
how lighter they would make the trip,
I wonder.

Tell you when I want to tell you,
and I always want to do so.
But I also want to always want to,
the love I feel, for granted? Boo. Tomato, tomato.

I want to show you everywhere,
and follow you everywhere you've been to too.
Tell me all the stories, let me in on details.
Your brain is fill with whimsy,
I want to see the world like you do.

Make me notice my habits, my motions, my catchphrases, my normalities.
Make me uncomfortably confortable, appallingly welcome to exist as me.

Que llegaras sin saberlo, recordarlo o incluso quererlo,
y que aún así lo intentes, y digas aún no merecerlo,
me llena de orgullo el alma, y más tu condición,
de amarte con todo y trapitos,
en inglés, alemán y español.

The words I tell you are but a millionth of the words I don't.
And so, even when they don't or can't rhyme,
I will always have Love ready for you, my Bug.

I may be forgetful, I regret being so scattered.
Match your effort with my patience, be my brakes and I'll be your gas,
May the last thing I forget be
the shape of your name between my gasps.

The one you turned after I met you,
the first of many in what I want to last,
long, long, auch für Ewigkeit,
bis ich nicht mehr atmen kann, bis du meine Neugier nie befriedigst.

I want to take long, unending walks with you,
see paths you never saw, make a path that never was.
Pick wildflowers on the way,
sit on the ground, and watch over the land.

My music is what moves me, since before I learned to speak.
You're beauty, you're fire, you are muse,
I don't want any other topics,
of your existence they shall sing.

Hearty meal, hearty soup, friends, time together, laughs.
Your own world colliding with mine,
like stars, together, a third, fuller system from it sprawls.

The end of all things, the beginning of a walk,
a journey, like you once it called.
What the end goal or the fall is, couldn't worry me much less,
for not the ending, but the journey is the reward.
